requirements.description: Microsoft FY2025 10-K: the reportable (operating) segments and, for each of Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud and More Personal Computing, the source's definition of its principal products, services and activities (the complete 'primarily comprises' enumeration with sub-enumerations), plus necessary qualifiers such as the FY2025 segment recomposition, OEM channel, cloud vs on-premises and CAL treatment. Business composition dimension, not revenue numbers.
